# Picmal

> Picmal is a native macOS application for batch converting and compressing images, videos, and audio files. It processes files entirely offline for privacy, supports drag-and-drop workflows, and integrates with Finder via right-click context menu options.

Picmal is designed for Mac users who need to convert media files quickly without uploading to cloud services. Key features include:

- Batch processing of thousands of files at once
- 100% offline processing (no data leaves your Mac)
- Finder integration via Services menu (right-click to convert/compress)
- Support for 20+ image formats including HEIC, WebP, AVIF, PNG, JPG, TIFF
- Video and audio conversion capabilities
- Adjustable quality and compression settings
- Metadata preservation during conversion

## Pricing

One-time purchase with lifetime license. No subscription required.
- 1-device license: $15.99
- 3-device license: $41.97
- 5-device license: $65.95

14-day money-back guarantee.

## Supported Formats

**Images:** HEIC, HEIF, JPG, JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, BMP, GIF, SVG, ICO, PDF
**Video:** MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV, WebM
**Audio:** MP3, WAV, AAC, FLAC, OGG
